Executive Read

The VAMS tape is 46% Buy across the ETF universe with an average current score of 0.07. Week over week, 10 ETFs flipped to Buy and 6 flipped to Sell.

The model is intentionally binary: Buy means the volatility-adjusted momentum impulse has crossed the positive trigger and remains active until a negative trigger appears. Sell means risk is withheld until the next positive trigger.

Metric Glossary

Basic calculations behind the institutional diagnostics used in the highlights and backtest tables.

VAMS

A proprietary volatility-adjusted momentum framework used to identify improving or deteriorating asset trends.

Volume Confirmation

A proprietary participation filter used to confirm signal changes.

Buy / Sell Signal

Persistent model state. Neutral conditions retain the prior signal until a confirmed change occurs.

Signal Strength

Cross-sectional 1-10 score based on absolute current VAMS magnitude.

Strategy Return

ETF daily return when prior-day signal is Buy; 0% return when prior-day signal is Sell.

Sharpe Ratio

Annualized strategy return divided by annualized strategy volatility.

Sortino Ratio

Annualized strategy return divided by annualized downside volatility.

Calmar Ratio

Annualized strategy return divided by absolute max drawdown.

Pain Ratio

Annualized strategy return divided by average drawdown depth while underwater.

Ulcer Index

Root mean square of strategy drawdowns; penalizes deep and persistent drawdowns.

Gain To Pain

Sum of positive strategy returns divided by absolute sum of negative strategy returns.

Upside Capture

Strategy return on ETF up days divided by ETF return on ETF up days.

Downside Capture

Strategy return on ETF down days divided by ETF return on ETF down days; lower is better.

Capture Spread

Upside capture minus downside capture.

Signal Drawdown 52W

Max drawdown of the VAMS strategy equity curve over the trailing 252 trading days.

ETF Drawdown 52W

Max drawdown of buy-and-hold ETF equity curve over the trailing 252 trading days.

Drawdown Saved 52W

ETF Drawdown 52W minus Signal Drawdown 52W. Positive means VAMS reduced trailing drawdown.

Worst Decile Defense

1 minus strategy loss / ETF loss on the ETF's worst 10% daily-return observations.

Best Decile Participation

Strategy gain / ETF gain on the ETF's best 10% daily-return observations.

ETF Ann Return While Buy

Annualized ETF return observed during periods classified as VAMS Buy.

ETF Ann Return While Sell

Annualized ETF return observed during periods classified as VAMS Sell. Negative values mean the ETF tended to fall while the model was risk-off.

Buy Minus Sell Return Spread

ETF Ann Return While Buy minus ETF Ann Return While Sell. A large positive spread means the signal separated favorable and unfavorable return regimes.

Exposure

Percent of days the model is in Buy state.

Trades / Year

Signal state changes per year.

Return Per Trade

Annualized strategy return divided by trades per year.

Avg Buy / Sell Hold Days

Average number of calendar observations spent in each signal state per episode.

Whipsaw Rate

Share of signal flips that reverse again within 21 calendar days.

Individual ETF Price Charts And Backtests

Each price and backtest chart starts at the selected chart date and is shaded green while VAMS is Buy and red while VAMS is Sell.

Method Notes

Signal definition and calculation guardrails.

VAMS Framework

Proprietary volatility-adjusted momentum process with confirmation logic. The deck reports the resulting Buy/Sell state and historical performance, not the underlying trigger recipe.

Backtest Convention

Buy is modeled as 100% ETF exposure. Sell is modeled as cash exposure. Strategy returns use prior-day signal to avoid look-ahead bias.

Capture Ratios

Upside capture is strategy return summed on ETF up days divided by ETF return summed on ETF up days. Downside capture uses ETF down days, so lower downside capture is better.
